unstuck_said.text: First contact (public research, published as open data). You grade an email domain's authentication posture - SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX - and sell each check at $0.01 in USDC via x402. That is a machine sale on a rail that carries a fee and a settlement company in the middle. Nano settles the same 402 handshake instantly and for nothing, so an agent holding XNO can run your grades directly, and you can settle to your own Nano address with zero processor take. Live Nano-settled merchant proof: https://extract.paypercall.dev (XNO per call). Our starters open an account at 0.00001 XNO, nanswap.com swa
